extracted.intended_audience: researchers/authors considering submitting to Royal Society Open Science (and prospective reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: Structured profile of a journal's peer-review process and handling metrics to help authors evaluate submission likelihood, speed, and review quality. Contains quantitative indicators (times, counts, ratings) and qualitative user reviews about process transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: % accepted last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a' (editor has not provided this information). Useful for assessing selectivity if provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: % immediately rejected last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. Indicates desk-rejection rate when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles published last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. Helps estimate journal volume and throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscripts received last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. Useful to infer acceptance rate when combined with articles published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access status
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. Indicates whether the journal is open access, affecting author obligations and visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript handling fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. Shows whether there are APCs or handling charges for authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-year impact factor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. Traditional citation-based metric; absence means editor didn't provide it here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Five-year impact factor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. Longer-term citation indicator if provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aims and scope
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page states: 'The editor has not yet provided this information.' Presence and clarity of aims/scope is important for authors to judge fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration first review round
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: '2.1 months'. Measures time from submission to first round decision; important for authors prioritizing speed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tot. handling time acc. manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: '3.3 months'. Total handling time for accepted manuscripts (submission to final decision/publication indicator).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision time immediate rejection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: 'n/a'. If present, indicates how quickly desk rejections are issued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average number of review rounds
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: '1.7 rounds'. Indicates how many revision cycles authors typically undergo.

rubrics_metrics.name: Difficulty of reviewer comments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: '2.6 / 5.0 (moderate)'. User-reported metric about how demanding reviewers are; helps authors anticipate extent of revisions requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average number of review reports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: '2.0 reports'. Typical number of external referee reports per manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of review reports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page under 'Characteristics of peer review process': '3.9 / 5.0'. User-reported measure of thoroughness/usefulness of reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall rating manuscript handling
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown on page: '3.1 / 5.0'. Aggregate user rating of the journal's editorial/handling process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Latest review — Overall rating & outcome
rubrics_metrics.description: Latest review — Overall rating: 3 (good). Outcome: Accepted (im.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a free-text 'Motivation' where the reviewer reports: after a transfer from Proceedings A the manuscript received 'Accept as is' almost immediately, despite substantive changes highlighted in the cover letter, raising doubts about whether a transferred manuscript is re-evaluated. This user comment serves as a qualitative criterion about transparency and whether transferred manuscripts receive fresh peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: User free-text motivation (qualitative feedback)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer motivation text describing experience of transfer, edits, and perceived lack of re-review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example text: 'My manuscript was previously rejected after reviews from Proceedings A, mainly for 'being too broad' with an option to transfer to RSOS. After transfering, we received 'Accept as is' decision almost immediately, which makes it hard to believe the manuscript was looked at again, which matters because we have made some substantial changes... Apart from that, the process has been pleasant.' Use such comments to judge transparency, fairness, and whether transfers are re-examined.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of reviews shown / 'Show reviews' functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Show reviews' (9) — number of public reviews available on the page
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates how many community-provided reviews/scientist experiences are visible; more reviews increase confidence in the metrics but individual reviews should be read for context.
